sentences.text: Shri Aditya Singh Ghuraiya - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri A.K.Nirankari - Public Prosecutor for the respondent

Order
This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner seeking quashment of FIR registered against him at Crime No.134/2022 at Police Station Daboh, District Bhind (MP) for the offences under punishable under Sections 450, 376(1) and 506 of IPC and consequential proceedings.
2. As per the status report, vide judgment dt.09.01.2024, impugned proceedings have been concluded by the trial Court.
Hence, the purpose of filing the instant petition is over and the petition has rendered infructuous.
3. In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives in this petition to address upon and the same is hereby dismissed having been rendered infructuous.
